name: Community Route - Investors Co-Leads And Boston Banner
description: The Investors community page now opens on a photo banner: the Back Bay skyline seen from Cambridge across the Charles, credited small in the corner because its CC BY-SA licence requires it. On a phone the wide panorama is cropped, so the entry sets its focus to 82% across to keep the Prudential Center in frame instead of the empty river on the left. Further down, the page shows two co-leads instead of one pilot lead: Stefan Pagacik and Kiran Govindaraju, each with a headshot, the shared role Investor Community Co-Lead, and a short bio (Stefan's trimmed to his current two companies).
